detail.longDescription: Been trying out https:// github.com/A-EDev/flow for a little while now as a cool way to have a private, local YouTube algorithm to serve you videos based on the topics you choose and what you watch. But after coming back to Mastodon to revisit some hashtags I used to love, it feels like a breath of fresh air, and I'm tired of the endless consumption I've fallen into with these local algorithm feeds, even if they did improve discoverability and the variety of "content" I watch to some extent. Life has been quite odd for a little while now (well, a few months for sure), and my phone plays this ever-changing role, where sometimes it helps me and other times it sinks or outright "destroys" me. When I have it as my main "friend" during periods of being alone (and that tends to be very often). I am looking to find ways to reclaim my productivity and control over what I do to a better extent, just lately I tend to fluctuate a lot between different feelings, states of mind and sanity. Alongside just generally thinking about what motivates me in the big picture to put in the work and "give it all my best"™ all the while my family is falling apart and I'm having to rethink a lot of things. Anywho, I hope you're having a good day, dear reader, sorry for the unexpected rant, but I felt like putting my thoughts out here might make this place feels less foreign to me and maybe ease my soul tensions a little. # foss # algorithm # offmychest # opensource # rant # feelings # emotions # youtube
